```yaml
id: vuln-portofino-94653cb3
languages:
  - java
message: Detected usage of insecure temporary file creation
severity: ERROR
metadata:
  CVE: CVE-2022-3952
  CWE: CWE-377, CWE-668
pattern: |
  method(name="createTempDir" 
    parameter-count=1 
    returns="java.io.File" 
    pattern-either(
      pattern-regexp(regexp=".*File.createTempFile.*", flags=["java"], message="Insecure temporary file creation", severity="ERROR"),
      pattern-regexp(regexp=".*File.mkdir.*", flags=["java"], message="Insecure temporary file creation", severity="ERROR")
    )
  )
```
This Semgrep rule will detect the usage of `File.createTempFile` or `File.mkdir` methods in the `createTempDir` method. It will flag these as potential vulnerabilities as they can lead to insecure temporary file creation.
